description: List the project's specifications, optionally filtered by status (draft | prepared | processing | completed) and scoped to a parent (`parentId`, CLI --parent) or to the top level (`topLevel`, CLI --top-level); the two are mutually exclusive. To find specs by topic, use specs_tree with `query` instead of walking this list. Returns an array ({items} in structuredContent).

parentId.description: Only direct children of this id (CLI: --parent).

name: specs_list
title: List specifications
